values./description: Create a scavenging location by choosing its scale (Tiny 6 items; Small 12; Average 18; Large 24), category, and degree of prior search. Degree sets search difficulty and reductions for Tiny locations: Untouched 0/2, Partly 1/3, Mostly 2/4, Heavily 3/5; multiply reductions by 2, 3, or 4 for larger scales. Roll here whenever a category lists Other. Location level is the total of CD equal to the PCs’ combined levels plus CD equal to search difficulty; each Effect adds 1 when problems are present.
